detail_html:
Welcome to [Akiracosme] Product Page!

AKIRACOSME – Curling Irons 3.0

✨ Signature Curls | Salon-Grade Shine | 10s Fast Heat | 4 Temp Settings

  • Models: AC-W1-32 / AC-W1-36 / AC-W1-40
  • Barrel size options: 32mm, 36mm, 40mm
  • Total length: 275mm
  • Temperature range: 140°C – 220°C (4 settings)
  • Heat‑up time: ~10 seconds
  • Curl time: ~5 seconds per section
  • Coating: Diamond Crystal Glaze (smooth, anti‑frizz, protective)
  • Heating element: HCM ceramic (fast, even heating)
  • Smart tech: AI intelligent constant temp (measures temp 50+ times/sec)
  • Safety features: long press 3 sec to start, insulated tip, air‑gap anti‑scald handle, 60‑min auto shut‑off
  • Cord: 1.8m with 360° swivel
  • Weight：0.44kg
  • Stand: silicone stand (tabletop safe)
  • Power: 60W / 66W / 70W, 100-240V (dual voltage), 50Hz

✧ How to Use

  1. Plug in, long press power button for 3 seconds to turn on.
  2. Select temperature (140–200°C). Wait ~10 sec to heat up.
  3. Take a small strand of dry hair, clamp middle to lower part.
  4. Rotate upwards, hold for about 5 seconds.
  5. Slowly pull down to ends. Release curl. Repeat as needed.
  6. Let curls cool. Turn off or auto shut‑off after 60 min. Place on silicone stand during use.

 

✧ Barrel Size Guide

32mm – short hair (above shoulders), inward curls

36mm – medium hair (to shoulders), Korean‑style large waves

40mm – long hair, sexy French large curls

✧ Why Choose Us?

● 30 Day Return Policy

● 1-year Brand Warranty=Free Replacement

● High-quality Japanese Brand Products

If you have any questions, please feel free to consult us at any time!

Why Choose Plantur 39 Brown?

detail_html:
Product Description

The RYO Root:Gen Hair Loss Care Shampoo for Women is a scalp-focused Korean shampoo designed to support healthier-looking roots and reduce visible hair shedding. It combines herbal scalp-care ingredients, caffeine, and botanical oils to deeply cleanse buildup while maintaining a fresher, lighter scalp environment.

Best For

  • Hair fall or shedding
  • Weak or thinning hair
  • Oily scalp
  • Flat or limp hair
  • Humid weather
  • Women wanting lightweight root volume

Key Ingredients

  • Caffeine – helps energize scalp and roots
  • Panax Ginseng Extract – traditional Korean herbal scalp-care ingredient
  • Thuja (Biota) Seed Extract – supports scalp vitality
  • Menthol – cooling and refreshing scalp sensation
  • Ceramide NP – helps support scalp moisture barrier
  • Camellia Seed Oil & Green Tea Seed Oil – lightweight nourishment
  • Centella Asiatica Extract – soothing scalp support
  • Rosemary, Bergamot & Lavender Oils – refreshing herbal aroma and scalp care

Texture & Scent

  • Rich foamy lather
  • Cleanses deeply without heavy residue
  • Cooling scalp sensation
  • Herbal-floral scent with bergamot and lavender notes
  • Leaves hair feeling airy and soft

Benefits

  • Helps reduce visible hair shedding
  • Removes scalp oil and buildup effectively
  • Gives lightweight volume at the roots
  • Helps scalp feel fresher longer
  • Supports softer and smoother hair texture

How to Use

  1. Apply to wet scalp and hair
  2. Massage gently into scalp for 1–2 minutes
  3. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water
  4. Follow with treatment or conditioner on mid-lengths and ends for better moisture balance

Things to Note

  • Contains fragrance and essential oils
  • Can feel deep-cleansing for very dry or bleached hair
  • Some users with sensitive scalp may prefer alternating with a gentler shampoo
  • Best results usually come with consistent use over several weeks

product.desc:
Why We Made This
  • Experience the buttery softness of lululemon Align™,in a dress. This version has ribbed trim at the neckline and straps while its sleek liner has a shelf bra for support, shorts with pockets, and an open-back waistband for easy bathroom breaks.
Fit Details
  • Intended to provide light support for B/C cups
  • Tight fit contours your body
  • Mini length falls to just above the centre of the kneecap
  • 4" shorts liner
  • Intended for low-impact activities
Design For
  • Yoga
Product Details
  • Built-in shelf bra for added support and coverage
  • Pockets for optional, removable cups
  • Shorts liner has side drop-in pockets and an open-back waistband to make bathroom breaks a breeze
  • Built-in liner offers extra coverage

lululemon is a technical athletic apparel brand designing gear for yoga, run, training and everything in between—but we’re more than just that. We’re a mindful movement that believes if we push past our sweaty boundaries, we’re able to build the strength to push ourselves in other aspects of life.This is who we are. This is lululemon.
product.highlights:
• So buttery soft, it feels weightless
  • Four-way stretch
  • Sweat-wicking
  • Breathable
  • Added Lycra® fibre for stretch and shape retention
  • Fully lined in a smooth four-way stretch, sweat-wicking fabric
  • Stretchy ribbed Nulu™ fabric at the neckline and straps
  • Materials:
    • Short:80% Polyamide, 20% Lycra Elastane,
    • Trim:79% Polyester (recycled), 21% Lycra Elastane,
    • Bra Lining:83% Polyester (recycled), 17% Elastane,
    • Body:81% Nylon, 19% Lycra Elastane,
    • Middle Layer:71% Polyester (recycled), 29% Lycra Elastane,
  • Feels Buttery-Soft and Weightless, Nulu™ Fabric

Fast and suitable area : 4 square cm spot size not too big or neither too small for any body curve, high efficiency and fast speed that just takes several minutes to remove the overlapping regin hair which is difficult for traditional hair removal method. 7. Skin Detection Ability: Numbers on LCD Display blinks when the unit is ready to work. 8. Permanent: IPL works inside pores, destroys hair papilla, thus achieves permanent hair removal. How to use it: Step 1: Shave your hair and dry your skin. Use a wipe to clean the flash window. Step 2: Plug device,the power button start to flash, which shows it is standby mode. Step 3: Press the power button for 2-5 seconds, the machine is starting up.Select energy level. Step 4: Place Flash Window vertically and firmly on your skin where you want to remove,Press the Flash button IPL Depilator's Principle: ---The principle of photonic hair removal is to use the selective photopyrolysis of the patented strong pulsed source to irradiate the normal epidermis without damage, penetrate the skin directly to the root of the hair follicle, and the melanin hair dry and hair follicle is absorbed and converted into heat energy, thus increasing the temperature of the hair follicle. ---When the temperature rises high enough, the follicle structure is irreversibly damaged, and the damaged hair and follicles are removed through a natural physiological process without damage to the surrounding tissue, resulting in painless hair removal. title: Pantogar Vegan Capsule Hair Loss Supplement ( For Woman ) 90 Cap
detail_text: For dietary management of diffuse hair loss in women Nutrient combination of B-vitamins, cystine and minerals to supply the hair root and for healthy hair growth Due to its composition, Pantogar® vegan is suitable to cover specific nutrients required in case of diffuse hair loss. Scientific data prove that the combination of B-vitamins, cystine and minerals meets the nutritional requirements for dietary management of diffuse hair loss. Directions for use: Take 1 capsule 3 times a day with some liquid. Important advice: Use under medical supervision. According to the appropriate use, the recommended daily maximum amounts for pantothenic acid, biotin and thiamine are exceeded. Not suitable as sole source of nutrition. Pantogar® vegan contains 0,3 mg biotin per capsule. If you are undergoing a laboratory test, you must tell your doctor or laboratory staff that you are taking or have recently taken Pantogar® vegan, as biotin can influence the results of such tests.
